newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING 1996 net profit rises 25.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: ING 1996 net profit rises 25.4 percent.

text.p: Financial services group ING Groep NV (ING) said on Thursday its net profit rose 25.4 percent to 3.32 billion guilders ($1.8 billion) from 2.65 billion in 1995.
The company, which took over British merchant bank Barings in 1995, said it was confident about the outlook for 1997 but it was too early yet to make a profit forecast.
Pre-tax banking profit rose 21.7 percent to 2.13 billion guilders. Pre-tax insurance profit rose 18.6 percent to 2.50 billion guilders.
ING said it was raising its dividend to 2.00 guilders per share from 1.66 in 1995.
The 1996 net profit figure was at the upper end of analysts' forecasts of 3.17 to 3.36 billion guilders.
Shortly after the results were published, ING shares were off 0.40 guilders at 69.90 on the Amsterdam bourse.
